Reference image is the approved default Starseer costume and painted dark-fantasy identity ONLY; completely remove the staff and star-shaped staff head. BOTH HANDS EMPTY in every frame, anatomically correct two arms and gloved hands with readable separated fingers; no weapons, shields, wands, books or held objects. Magic intent must read entirely through deliberate open-palm channeling gestures, controlled posture and measured release, never punches or boxing. All full-body poses face screen-right at consistent three-quarter side angle, character scale identical, boots baseline consistent, all fingers/hat/cloth inside each cell with generous transparent padding. Generate the ENTIRE coherent suite at once in exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, all 16 cells occupied, square 2048 atlas, clean genuine transparent alpha background. Row 4: (1) AGGRESSIVE STANCE forward weight, empty open right palm poised toward foe, left open hand drawn back; (2) DEFENSIVE STANCE rear weight, two open hands protecting head and torso; (3) PORTRAIT bust of same Starseer hat and robe identity, no hands or props; (4) CONVERSATION relaxed fullbody, one open empty hand at waist in a small conversational gesture, other resting at side.
